title: Goggles
tagline: Seamlessly Organize your files using AI privately on a decentralized network
description:
Goggles runs as a background service on your OS, where it listens to all Screenshot events, analyzes the picture, and renames it meaningfully. All while keeping your data private and secure (Powered by Zero Gravity)

Goggles is a small prototype to demonstrate the importance of Local First Native network interactions, which is an obvious evolution towards truly private DApps.
how_its_made: This project uses a Rust-based backend to run Goggles as a background service on Mac, while the frontend is built on React and transpiled to a native application. We used Solidity to write contracts that act as the mapping DB, which is deployed on 0G to interact with LLMs natively
